name: Move Earth

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a 40-foot-square area of earth you can see

summary: Reshape dirt, sand or clay in a 40-foot square, up to 20 feet up or down.
text: Each reshaping takes 10 minutes, and you can pick a new area with a Magic action. It can't touch natural stone or buildings, and the slow change never traps or harms creatures.
